prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent game VFX sprite animation atlas for Caelum Argenteum, an independent dark fantasy FPS-RPG inspired by nineteenth-century Argentina. Create one atlas with EXACTLY two rows and four equal square cells per row, 4 columns by 2 rows, generous transparent gutters, each frame completely isolated within its cell. No text, no grid lines, no background, no floor, no people, no wounds, no objects, no logos. Hand-painted pixel-oriented game artwork, readable small silhouettes, restrained soft shading, no glossy modern 3D, no anime outlines. TOP ROW: four consecutive frames of one small neutral gray stone-dust bullet-impact puff: compact first puff, expanding broken wisps, loose dispersing dust, faint final wisps. No muzzle flame, sparks or bullet. BOTTOM ROW: four consecutive frames of one small dark crimson airborne blood particle/splash effect, just detached abstract liquid droplets: compact spray, spreading irregular droplets, separated downward droplets, sparse fading droplets. No gore anatomy, organs, violence scene or puddle. Maintain the same visual center and consistent scale throughout each row. Each effect occupies the middle half of its cell, with clean transparent edges and alpha gaps around all cells. This must be newly painted original artwork and must not reproduce Doom sprites, layouts or pixels. Fully transparent background; preserve soft particle alpha.
